t: Escaping GitHub Pages: The Quest for Raw Log Files and Deeper SEO Insights
s: The author is moving from GitHub Pages to self-hosting to gain access to raw web server logs for advanced SEO analysis, particularly to understand AI bot behavior, using NixOS to manage the complexity of self-hosting.
sub: Gaining raw log file access for AI bot behavior analysis.
Turing machine as a metaphor for sequenced actions and computation.
Strategic site structure and click-depth management.
Data analysis for identifying and promoting top-performing content.
